name: tenant-background-check
description: Local, privacy-preserving checks for rental application packages (credit report tampering, cross-document consistency).

scripts.release: npm run build && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && gh release create tbc-v$npm_package_version dist/checker.html --target "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" --title "Tenant File Checker v$npm_package_version"
